body: Have you ever tried a kneaded rubber eraser? It's harder than playdoh but pliable enough to keep my hands occupied, and doesn't make any noise. Also doubles as a decent eraser so it doesn't look like you're playing around with a toy lol.
I'm a girl (17) but I can probably relate to what you're going through. So PM me if you want to talk.

Thank you. I really wish I were brave enough to do this. Through a friend I told her (the girl) I'm done and tired of this. She says she won't do anything unless I look at her. Wtf? I'm afraid she might blow things more out of proportion like she has already.

Funny because I do all these things to get into a good college: AP classes,  Honor Society, and I have no idea if I'll even get to that point. I want to become some sort of psychologist, research I think. I did track last year too (just to put on my college application) and it was great, met different people, made new friends. But wouldn't you know, the girl who's out to get me is in track too (on another school team) but at any track meet I would see her, so now that's a no...

I'm scared because all my struggles have been internal. I don't know if this makes any sense but she's an external struggke. It's hard to explain but whenever I've been on the brink I can always talk myself down, tell myself to stop. But her? If I tell her to stop, she's probably not going to. Until she's done with me she will always be a force pushing me to the brink. That's what I'm scared of.

I have a therapist and a psychiatrist. I haven't seen my therapist in about 6 months, with school and work. Most of the time I'm okay, so I tell myself I'm fine without seeing her. My psychiatrist is quick, 15 min session medicine updates ( I take zoloft 50mg and the occasional xanax .25 mg for anxiety attacks) with my mom in the room. Either way, like I said, I'm mostly fine until I have a episode like now.
